item: 2025 Document Checklist for Parents and Grandparents (IMM 5771)
Application to Sponsor, Sponsorship Agreement and Undertaking (IMM 1344), signed by the sponsor, co-signer and principal applicant
Financial Evaluation for Parents and Grandparents (IMM 5768)
Income Sources (IMM 5748)
condition: sponsor or co-signer answered No to IMM 5768 question 8 or 16

item: Statutory Declaration of Common-law Union (IMM 5409)
condition: sponsor and co-signer are common-law partners

item: Generic Application Form (IMM 0008), principal applicant
note: Declare the spouse and every dependent child

item: Additional Family Information (IMM 5406), principal applicant and each dependant 18 or older
Schedule A (IMM 5669), principal applicant and each dependant 18 or older, no gaps
Your Travels (IMM 5562), principal applicant and each dependant 18 or older
Use of a Representative (IMM 5476), separate forms for sponsor and principal applicant if both use one
Sponsor: 2025 Invitation to Apply letter
Sponsor: proof of status (PR card both sides, IMM 1000/5292/5688, citizenship certificate or card, Canadian birth certificate, or Indian status)
Sponsor: marriage certificate
condition: the co-signer is the sponsor's spouse

item: Co-signer: proof of status
Sponsor: own birth certificate (and the parent's, if sponsoring grandparents)
Passport or travel document of the principal applicant and each accompanying dependant
Principal applicant's marriage certificate or IMM 5409; proof of dissolution of earlier unions
condition: principal applicant has a spouse or partner

item: Birth certificate or adoption order for each dependent child
CV or resume of the principal applicant and each dependant 18 or older, since age 18, no gaps
Details of Government Employment (IMM 0149), Police Service (IMM 0150), Military Experience (IMM 5546)
condition: declared at IMM 5669 sections F or G

item: One recent photo of the principal applicant and each accompanying dependant
Fee receipt (sponsorship, application and biometrics fees on one receipt)
Notices of Assessment for tax years 2022, 2023 and 2024
condition: sponsor or co-signer answered No to IMM 5768 question 8 or 16
note: Police certificates and medicals: not now, IRCC asks later
